dedupe_keys.name: european database on the energy performance and water footprint of data centres

description: The European database on data centres collects and publishes energy performance and water footprint information from data centres in the European Union, under Article 12 of the recast Energy Efficiency Directive and Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2024/1364, published in May 2024. Operators of data centres with an installed information technology power demand of at least 500 kW must report yearly on energy consumption, installed IT power, power usage effectiveness, temperature set points, waste heat reuse, water use, renewable energy share and whether they provide grid services; national authorities coordinate reporting, and the Commission publishes aggregated data at member-state and EU level through an online dashboard on its Policy Reporting Platform, together with a report on data-centre energy efficiency in the EU. It is produced by the Commission's Directorate-General for Energy to prepare an EU sustainability rating scheme for data centres. Coverage: EU member states, annual reporting from 2024 onwards, aggregated by country; individual site data are confidential. Format and access: web dashboard and PDF reports, free of charge; reporting operators register on the platform. Caveats: only aggregated figures are public; early reporting rounds are incomplete; definitions follow the delegated regulation and can change with the rating scheme. Simulation uses: environmental impact and demand inputs for energy system and water planning, capacity planning of grids hosting data centres, and policy evaluation of efficiency rules. Related records: the LBNL US data centre energy report and IEA Energy and AI estimates give comparable figures for the US and the world.
